references: krish-chat-2026-11-17-rio-meets (the Rio Meets 'I LOVE CRISTIANO!' thumbnail Krish sent: two cutout faces large either side, the headline huge between them on a deep colour)
title: Face-led covers: three options, wide and tall
goal: Krish approved face-led covers for his own accounts (TikTok, X, LinkedIn) and the face arm of a YouTube test. Draw three options for one past piece, headline "WHO TRAINS YOUR 2030 SENIORS?" (Monday follow.the.money), each in two sizes: wide 1280x720 and tall 1080x1920. Each option uses a different cutout from .scratch/covers/photos/ (denim, glasses, natural). The face is cut out, large, about a third of the frame, on the series colour, never a circle; the headline is the largest thing, at most two or three lines, bright over dark. Write a small Python renderer (Pillow) at .scratch/covers/draw.py that makes all six files, then run it.
contract: Outputs: .scratch/covers/out/option-{1,2,3}-wide.png (1280x720) and option-{1,2,3}-tall.png (1080x1920). Colours and fonts only from the Brand sections below and config/ve/brand-tokens.json; fonts from the repository's font files named there, never a system font. At most three parts besides the headline: the face, the quiet series label, the wordmark. No logos, badges or proof tags. His name never appears. The tall cover keeps the headline and face inside the 3:4 grid crop and clear of the caption zone (config/channel-safe-zones.json). Never edit, recolour or redraw the photos: scale and position only.
acceptance:
python3 .scratch/covers/draw.py
python3 -c "from PIL import Image; import sys; [sys.exit(1) for n in (1,2,3) for s,w,h in (('wide',1280,720),('tall',1080,1920)) if Image.open(f'.scratch/covers/out/option-{n}-{s}.png').size!=(w,h)]"
python3 scripts/channel_safe.py --shape cover_tall .scratch/covers/out/option-1-tall.png
python3 scripts/channel_safe.py --shape cover_tall .scratch/covers/out/option-2-tall.png
python3 scripts/channel_safe.py --shape cover_tall .scratch/covers/out/option-3-tall.png
